name: Cavitation / head

request.text: 2-second dry close game SFX. One head bursts like a ripe pumpkin: a sharp wet hollow pop, crunchy shell rupture, dense pulp splatter and a few falling blood drops. A hollow suction gulp, liquid pressure pop and acidic spray. Natural quick decay. No voice, scream, music, weapon shot, ambience or reverb.
